answer: Use rotating admission bonds with audit lotteries. 1) Each new key locks 42 POA for 28 days and signs a task commitment. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established peers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied output fingerprints, or synchronized payouts merge accounts into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond.
